description: Lethenia wears a fully opaque ivory floor-length gown with a high boat neckline and sleeves reaching the wrists. Gold and deep plum woven geometric borders decorate the neckline, center front, cuffs and skirt hem. A broad plum outer drape covers the shoulders and hangs along both sides, secured at one shoulder by a round bronze brooch. A narrow patterned waist belt has a central round fastening. A subtle wrist cuff provides restrained jewelry. Brown-purple embroidered leather shoes show beneath the closed skirt. Face, minimal neck and hands are exposed; no headgear, armor or weapon appears.
